name: Hotta Koumei
source:
A student at [url=/c113092]Minase Emi[/url]'s class. Member of the basketball club.

He isn't good at studying, but because he gets along well with his former class teacher [url=/c114411]Hayasaka Minoru[/url], he does his best.

Has a girlfriend from another school, and is worried how he could have sex with her. He couldn't quite make a step to lose his virginity. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/098/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
